edges.note: Bundling related values into one aggregate passed as a unit is the object-scale form of the encapsulate tactic.
A bulk get/set applies one operation to a whole set of elements - the Aggregate usability tactic at API scale.
Fusing a common call sequence into one interface method executed as a single unit gives it transaction-like atomicity.
Lazy first-call construction defers when the object is bound/created to runtime.
Externally supplied dependencies are the assembly mechanism component architectures rely on to wire replaceable components.
An external assembler binds concrete collaborators at deployment/startup rather than in the component's code.
Runtime-checked pre/postconditions and invariants are hand-coded executable assertions on data validity.
An internal DSL is a little language whose constructs are evaluated by host-language machinery - the interpreter style at library scale.
Internal iteration applies a client operation to each element without exposing the collection's representation.
Separating a usage contract into an interface type is the encapsulate tactic: clients depend only on the interface, not internals.
Explicit provided-interface types are the precondition for components with declared provided/required interfaces.
Chained expressions translated into a normal command-query API build an internal-DSL expression evaluated by the host.
An expression builder is the concrete construct that provides the fluent interface over a command-query API.
Multiple role-specific interfaces reached via a root interface (QueryInterface) is the component-interface mechanism of COM-style components.
A fixed facade whose backend is chosen per target at build/link time binds the implementation at compile/link (component replacement).
A fluent interface builds configuration/computation as an internal DSL read and executed by the host language.
A mode/flag parameter selecting among behaviors is runtime behavior configuration of a single routine.
Variadic option functions are the Go mechanism for configuring a component's behavior at construction.
The implementable HAL interface set is the design-scale realization of the architectural HAL layer (same concept, two realms).
Re-declaring the widgets from application state every frame makes the view a pure function of state re-derived each cycle.
IMGUI (rebuild each frame) and retained mode (persistent scene model) are the two opposing GUI API styles.
A separate interface exposing a component's capability/configuration metadata is the meta-level self-representation of the Reflection pattern.
Container-invoked lifecycle methods (init/activate/passivate/destroy) are the mechanism by which a container manages hosted components.
Named chained setters on a parameter object configure a call's behavior by named argument rather than position.
The C++ named-parameter idiom realizes a fluent interface for argument passing.
Returning data through caller-supplied pointers is a parameter-passing convention of the procedure-call connector.
A plugin linked at configuration time is the extension mechanism that plug-in/microkernel architectures are built from.
Selecting behavior per deployment via configuration binds the implementation late (deployment-time).
Mapping a specification to a concrete product class at runtime defers the binding of type to run time.
A persistent retained scene graph/widget tree is a central data structure that client code and the renderer operate on.
A locator resolving a concrete provider at runtime is the in-process realization of a service registry.

edges.cite: Fowler, 'Inversion of Control Containers and the Dependency Injection pattern' (contrasts Service Locator vs DI)
edges.note: Two competing ways to obtain a dependency; Fowler explicitly weighs them against each other.
Making the only constructor validate/normalize is an abstract-data-type discipline that keeps invalid values (and their exceptions) from arising.
A named static creator hides the concrete class and instantiation choice behind a stable creation interface.
Cohesive type-safe classes over low-level non-portable system APIs introduce an interface hiding the OS internals.
Creating a whole product family behind an interface defers the choice of concrete family to configuration/runtime.
An opaque per-client session object held by the server encapsulates that client's server-side session state.
The whole point of Acyclic Visitor is to break the dependency cycle between element and visitor hierarchies.
A Visitor variant using a degenerate base visitor to remove the cyclic dependency.
An Adapter converting one class's interface to what clients expect is the object-scale adaptor connector.
Decoupling abstraction from implementation hides the implementation hierarchy behind the abstraction's interface.
Separating construction from representation encapsulates a complex build process behind a stable director/builder interface.
A self-maintaining hierarchy of cooperating elements propagating changes up and down mirrors the PAC agent hierarchy.
Passing a request along a chain of candidate handlers is the object realization of a staged processing chain.
Reifying a request as an object with execute/unexecute is the mechanism that maintains reversible-operation information for undo.
A command processor that logs and stores command objects supplies the checkpoint/history that undo/redo depends on.
The command processor schedules, executes, logs and stores reified Command objects.
Splitting an entity's state/behavior into per-domain components composed at runtime is component-based structuring at object scale.
Part-whole trees treated uniformly are the recursive containment structure applied to objects.
A collector threaded through methods, each writing its partial result, is a shared structure accumulating partial solutions.
CRTP resolves polymorphic calls at compile time, removing the virtual-dispatch indirection - a per-event overhead reduction.
Wrapping an object to add responsibilities without changing its class adds capability to the same interface.
Forwarding requests to a helper is the object-composition mechanism underpinning object-oriented organization (composition over inheritance).
A stateless domain-layer operation defined by what it does is a first-class element of the DDD domain model.
Dispatching on two runtime types is a dynamic-dispatch mechanism of the object-oriented style.
Visitor is realized by a pair of single dispatches (double dispatch).
A shared-base handle/body split hides the letter (body) implementation behind the envelope handle.
Envelope-Letter is a handle/body variant where handle and bodies share a common base class.
Asking an object for an extension implementing a given interface adds capabilities without changing the object's class.
Wrapping unrelated concrete classes in a parallel adapter hierarchy adapts them to one uniform polymorphic interface.
A unified higher-level interface hiding a subsystem is the encapsulate tactic applied to a subsystem.
Deferring which class to instantiate to subclasses binds the concrete type late.
Sharing intrinsic state across many fine-grained objects improves memory-usage efficiency.
Looking up a handler in a function-pointer table binds the invoked behavior late, replacing hard-coded branch chains.
An overridable extension-point method defers the concrete behavior to a subclass/client (late binding of a step).
Template Method calls hook methods at its designed variation points.
Registered interceptors invoked automatically at framework dispatch points are implicitly invoked handlers on internal events.
A class-per-grammar-rule interpret operation over an AST is the object realization of the interpreter style.
Sequential access without exposing the aggregate's representation is the encapsulate tactic for traversal.
A common supertype holding behavior shared by all types in a layer is a structuring aid for the Layers pattern.
An object mediating between two subsystems that stay ignorant of each other is an interposed intermediary breaking the dependency.
An empty tagging interface is static metadata about a class, queried (via type checks/reflection) to drive behavior.
Encapsulating how colleagues interact so they refer only to the mediator interposes an intermediary that breaks their direct dependencies.
Capturing and externalizing state to restore later is the snapshot/checkpoint mechanism undo relies on.
A reusable behavior slice composed into many classes factors a shared capability into one general unit.
All instances sharing static state make the class a single shared data store that many holders operate on.
Monostate (shared static state, free construction) and Singleton (single instance) are alternative ways to get global-shared behavior.
A map of exactly-one-instance-per-key is a keyed registry of instances.
Multiton generalizes Singleton to one instance per key.
A non-virtual public interface delegating to private virtual hooks fixes the public contract while hiding the variable implementation.
NVI is a disciplined form of Template Method with non-virtual public methods and private virtual hooks.
A do-nothing stand-in makes 'no object' a normally handled case rather than a null-check fault.
Null Object is the 'absent' specialization of Special Case.
Encapsulation/inheritance/polymorphism via struct embedding and function-pointer tables organizes plain C as ADT instances.
Distributing request handling recursively over a polymorphic structure is recursive containment applied to behavior.
Object Recursion typically walks a Composite structure, each node handling its part and delegating the rest.
A one-to-many change-notification dependency is the object-scale realization of publish-subscribe (mission calibration anchor).
Notifying registered dependents on state change is the mechanism implicit-invocation/event-based systems depend on.
Per-class function-pointer vtables plus self pointers realize dynamic-dispatch objects in C.
The explicit-vtable technique is one concrete way of doing object orientation in C.
Storing a method name and dispatching on it reflectively uses run-time self-representation of methods.
Assembling behavior from orthogonal policy template parameters binds each aspect at compile time (build-time selection).
Policy-Based Design is the compile-time, template-parameter counterpart of runtime Strategy.
Moving state into a separate data object exposed read-only tightens encapsulation of a class's data.
Creating objects by cloning a prototypical instance defers what gets created to a runtime-configured exemplar.
A surrogate with the same interface interposed to control access to a subject is an interposed intermediary.
A well-known object other objects use to find common services is the in-process realization of a service registry.
Attaching/detaching role objects at runtime adds and hides capabilities per client context without changing the core class.
Defining an interface in a separate package so clients depend only on it restricts inter-module dependencies.
A helper class providing one common behavior to a group of unrelated classes factors that shared service into one place.
A single shared instance providing a global access point is a central shared datum many components operate on.
A subclass giving defined behavior for particular cases handles states that would otherwise be faults as normal operation.
Encapsulating a business rule as a combinable predicate object evaluated against candidates is a small rule engine.
Choosing the best resource at runtime via sponsors and a selector defers the selection decision to run time.
Delegating state-dependent behavior to interchangeable state objects realizes an explicit states-plus-transitions organization.
Interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface are the plug-in mechanism microkernel/plug-in architectures build on (mission calibration).
Selecting one of a family of encapsulated algorithms binds behavior late (runtime or configuration).
Subclasses may only combine a fixed suite of protected operations, restricting what they can depend on.
Subclass Sandbox is a Template-Method-family pattern giving subclasses a curated operation set to implement the abstract sandbox method.
An algorithm skeleton deferring specific steps to subclass hooks binds those steps late (at subclassing time).
Coupling two partner objects to simulate multiple inheritance is an object-composition mechanism within OO organization.
Representing a category as a runtime object instances reference is a core Adaptive Object-Model building block (types as data).
A component that opens, coordinates, tiles and closes all views centralizes view/navigation control like an application controller.
Externalizing operations over an object structure is the mechanism AST-traversal passes use to add compiler phases without touching node classes.
An aggregate that is the sole access point to its encapsulated parts hides those parts behind one interface.
Whole-Part organizes constituent parts; Composite is the recursive tree specialization of that idea.
The result-verification phase of the four-phase structure is where executable assertions on the SUT's output live.
Capturing the full observed output as a stored reference and asserting equality is record/playback applied to test verification.
Stripping hard-to-test glue to a trivial shell isolates and encapsulates the environmental dependency away from testable logic.
A factory of ready-made canonical example objects supplies substitutable test data to tests.
Wrapping a UI page behind an application-specific API isolates the volatile UI structure behind a stable test interface.
Running one test body per row of an input/expected table abstracts test inputs into a substitutable data source.
Fixed tabular cases vs universally-quantified generated inputs are two data-driven testing approaches.
Checking a universally-quantified property over many generated inputs is executable assertions over drawn data.
Substituting an in-process stand-in for a problematic external service isolates the SUT from the real world for testing.
A service stub is a stub-family test double standing in for an external service.
A defaulting fluent builder constructs substitutable, easily-varied test data for tests.
A test data builder is the Builder pattern applied to constructing test objects with defaults and with-methods.
Replacing a production dependency with a controlled double removes a source of behavioral nondeterminism from the test.
An arranged, controlled pre-test state isolates the SUT in a known environment for repeatable experimentation.

unbridged.why: Pure C++ translation-unit static-initialization-order idiom (Schwarz counter); no specific architecture element governs cross-TU init ordering - bridged laterally to construct-on-first-use instead.

notes: Every design element except nifty-counter carries >=1 realizes/enables edge to a specific architecture element. Heavy use of modifiability/testability tactics (defer-binding, encapsulate, restrict-dependencies, limit-structural-complexity) plus specific styles (interpreter, publish-subscribe, microkernel, adaptive-object-model, reflection, blackboard) and connectors (adaptor, procedure-call). Testing-constructs map to Bass testability tactics (executable-assertions, record-playback, sandbox, abstract-data-sources, limit-nondeterminism, limit-structural-complexity). Provenance is almost entirely editorial: these object-to-architecture realizations are standard but not stated verbatim in a single citable source loaded this session; only the Service-Locator-vs-DI contrast is sourced (Fowler). MISSING arch targets I wanted but did not find: (1) a Plug-in / plugin-architecture STYLE distinct from microkernel (mission hint referenced 'plug-in' but the catalog only has microkernel); (2) a Command-Processor architecture pattern (only exists as a design element here, so Command bridges to the undo tactic instead); (3) a Dependency-Inversion principle node; (4) a Lazy-Initialization / initialization-ordering tactic that would cleanly host construct-on-first-use and nifty-counter.
